name: The Noble's Manor
summary: An iron-gated house with a carriage, at the east end of the square. Its master is the town's largest spice buyer — a man of cultivated tastes who collects instruments. One sale could carry you for half a month — but a noble with a carriage is exactly the sort the one in the case half-joked could 'carry you off, indirectly.'
affordances: Sell spice in bulk to the Count (high price, but talk it well)
Let him hear a passage — he has taken an interest in the violin
Take his carriage out of town (a price: you must give up something)
hook: The Count wants to buy your violin. What will the spirit say? And could you bear to sell your only companion?
